discovery.mission_query: Find 10 US-headquartered companies with 51-200 employees, with their VP of Sales where available. Do not broaden.
discovery.why_this_mission: Every hard criterion is one both providers filter EXACTLY (LeadOcean hqCountry=US, min/maxEmployees; Apollo organization_locations, organization_num_employees_ranges) and the shared engine can decide from canonical evidence (HQ flag and declared size band on the company record). An industry was left out on purpose: Agentory's controlled business-model vocabulary ('B2B SaaS') has no exact LeadOcean label, and LeadOcean's labels ('Software Development') are outside that vocabulary, so no industry wording is decidable by both — it would refuse one provider or leave every company pending.
